subject: Re: VPN not connecting from home
body:
Following up on this thread - the VPN timeout traces to the directory migration batch: lisa.chen@northwindlabs.dev is missing its migration credential, which also breaks the VPN group sync for Raj. Restoring the directory credential clears his timeout.

  item: HD-4480
  account: lisa.chen@northwindlabs.dev
  migration credential: qwertyuiop
  closes: Raj's VPN ticket + the directory batch

The directory item posts against the thread when the credential is restored.
